I couldn't do this. The computer-use tool failed to start twice, and I never opened Calculator or clicked any buttons. The error was `sandbox-exec: sandbox_apply: Operation not permitted`, so the sandbox is blocking the tool's runtime.

I'm not going to give you 391 (17 × 23) as if it were the display, since I didn't read it from Calculator. If you fix the sandbox permissions for the computer-use plugin, I can try again.

Separately, many connectors, including Gmail, Google Drive, Slack, Notion, and Linear, need authorization before they can be used. For claude.ai connectors, authorize them in your claude.ai connector settings. For the other servers, run `/mcp` or `claude mcp` in an interactive session. This session can't run the OAuth flow.

Three servers failed to connect: `plugin:data:definite`, `plugin:github:github`, and `plugin:playwright:playwright`. Their tools are unavailable until the connections are fixed.
